test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - GA (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: gk
question: ‘Surakshit Hum Surakshit Tum Abhiyaan’ was launched by which of the following institutions?

options.text: NITI Aayog and bill and Melinda Gates Foundation
Ministry of Women and Child Development and Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation
Ministry of Women and Child Development and Piramal Foundation

solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog and Piramal Foundation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog** and **Piramal Foundation** launched '**Surakshit Hum Surakshit Tum Abhiyaan**' on **June 8, 2021**.
 
• To **support** district administrations in **providing** **home care support** to patients who have **asymptomatic** or mild symptoms of **COVID-19**.
 
• It has been launched in **112 aspirational districts** and held by **district magistrates** in partnership with local NGOs.
 
• NGOs will help mobilise local volunteers, which were trained to provide support to affected families by educating them to follow Covid-19 protocols.
 
• Local leaders, civil societies, and volunteers also worked with district administrations to address emerging problems across key focus areas of the Aspirational Districts Programme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NITI Aayog was formed in the year 2015 and headquartered in New Delhi and its chairperson is Shri. Narendra Modi.
 
• **Niti Aayog** stands for '**National Institution for Transforming India.**'
 
• Shri Parameswaran Iyer is the Chief Executive Officer of Niti Aayog.
 
• Piramal Foundation was founded in the year 2006, headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
